title: LeadScore
description: Output contract for prompts/01-lead-scoring.md. Score 0-100; tier A >= 80, B 60-79, C < 60.

score.description: Combined score 0-100: round(0.6 * fit_score + 0.4 * intent_score) unless the rubric overrides weights.

fit_score.description: Company + persona match to the ICP rubric, 0-100.

intent_score.description: Strength of buying signals (hiring, funding, growth, tech adoption), 0-100.

reasoning.description: 1-3 plain-language sentences naming the specific facts that drove the score.

confidence.description: 0-1; lower when key fields were missing or stale.

missing_data.description: Rubric factors that could not be assessed from the lead record.

disqualified.description: True if a hard disqualifier from the rubric matched.
